    # We need to cluster at firm level. Get firm identifiers

    print(f"t-statistic: {did_t_stat:.3f}")
    print(f"P-value: {did_pval:.4f}")
    print(f"Significant at 5%: {did_significant}")
    
    # ========================================================================

    # ========================================================================

    print("PART 2: PARALLEL TRENDS CHECK")

    pre_treatment_years = [y for y in pre_treatment_years if y < 2020]

    for year in pre_treatment_years:
        year_data = df[df['year'] == year]
        treated_mean = year_data[year_data['treated'] == 1]['revenue_growth_pct'].mean()
        control_mean = year_data[year_data['treated'] == 0]['revenue_growth_pct'].mean()
        diff = treated_mean - control_mean
        trend_difference.append(diff)
        
        print(f"{year}: Treated={treated_mean:.3f}, Control={control_mean:.3f}, "
              f"Diff={diff:.3f}")
        
        # Check if difference is growing significantly over time
        if len(trend_difference) > 1:
            # Test if the trend is significantly increasing
            years_array = np.array([pre_treatment_years[i] for i in range(len(trend_difference))])
            trend_values = np.array(trend_difference)
            
            # Simple test: check if earlier years have similar differences
            year0_diff = trend_difference[0]
            year1_diff = trend_difference[1]
            p_value = stats.ttest_ind(
                [trend_difference[i] for i in range(0, len(trend_difference)//2)],
                [trend_difference[i] for i in range(len(trend_difference)//2, len(trend_difference))]
            )
            
    print("\nParallel Trends Assessment:")
    if len(pre_treatment_years) >= 3:
        print(f"Differences in first 3 pre-treatment years:")
        for i in range(min(3, len(pre_treatment_years))):
            print(f"  {pre_treatment_years[i]}: {trend_difference[i]:.3f}")
        print(f"  {pre_treatment_years[-1]}: {trend_difference[-1]:.3f}")
    
    # Check if the trend is flat (parallel)
    if len(pre_treatment_years) >= 2:
        early_diffs = trend_difference[:len(trend_difference)//2]
        late_diffs = trend_difference[len(trend_difference)//2:]
        
        t_test = stats.ttest_ind(early_diffs, late_diffs)
        parallel_check = abs(t_test.statistic) < 1.96  # Not significantly different
    
    print(f"Parallel trends test: {'PASS' if parallel_check else 'WARNING'}")
    
    # ========================================================================
    # PART 3: INDUSTRY-LEVEL ANALYSIS
    # ========================================================================
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("PART 3: INDUSTRY-LEVEL TREATMENT EFFECT ANALYSIS")
    print("=" * 60)
    
    # Regress DID effect on industry (simple analysis)
    industry_effect = df.groupby('industry')['revenue_growth_pct'].agg({
        'treated': 'mean',
        'treated_post_2020': lambda x: (x & (df.loc[x.index, 'year'] >= 2020) if isinstance(x, pd.Series) else sum(df.loc[x.index, 'year'] >= 2020))
    })
    
    # Calculate average revenue growth by industry in post period for treated firms
    industry_stats = {}
    for industry in df['industry'].unique():
        industry_data = df[df['industry'] == industry]
        treated_data = industry_data[industry_data['treated'] == 1]

            print(f"{ind:<20}{sign}{effect:>6.2f}%")

    print(f"- DID Estimate: {did_coef:.4f}")

    # Additional diagnostics
    print("\n" + "-" * 60)
    print("Additional Diagnostics:")
    print("-" * 60)
    
    # Overall revenue growth trend
    print(f"\nAverage revenue growth (pre-2020): {(df[df['year'] < 2020]['revenue_growth_pct']).mean():.2f}%")
    print(f"Average revenue growth (post-2020): {(df[df['year'] >= 2020]['revenue_growth_pct']).mean():.2f}%")
